why.title: Vaccines are not just for babies
why.body: Protection from childhood shots can fade, some vaccines are needed every year, and new risks appear with age and health conditions.

points.d: A timely vaccine stops an illness before it starts, saving lost days and medical bills.
Vaccinated adults are far less likely to pass infections to children and elders at home.
Government-approved vaccines, an unbroken cold chain and trained professionals at your door.

doctor.title: Want a doctor to confirm?
doctor.body: Our doctors will check your history and suggest the right vaccines and schedule.

faq.q: Is this check a medical diagnosis?
faq.a: No. It is an indicative guide based on commonly followed vaccine schedules for your age and health. Please confirm with a doctor before vaccination, especially if you are pregnant or have a medical condition.
Protection from some childhood vaccines fades over time, some vaccines like flu are needed every year, and risks such as pneumonia and shingles rise with age and chronic illness.
Book the vaccine on PharmEasy. It reaches you in a cold-chain box and a trained professional gives it at home. Vaccine administration is free.

faq.q: Can I take more than one vaccine on the same day?
faq.a: Many vaccines can be given together, but it depends on the vaccines and your health. Our doctors can help you plan the schedule.
Your answers are used only to prepare your vaccine plan and to help our team reach you about it. We do not share them with advertisers.

disclaimer: This tool gives general information based on standard vaccination schedules and is not a substitute for medical advice. Always consult a qualified doctor before taking any vaccine. Prices are current PharmEasy starting rates and may change.

deeplink._note: Product links per platform. {id} is the PharmEasy medicine id. Mweb inside the PharmEasy app uses the android/ios deeplink; desktop and any other browser use web.
